data.title: 爱丽丝 · 卢利特麦浪中的农家围裙回首
data.description: 金黄麦浪滚滚起伏的卢利特村原野，午后微风吹过草木清香。爱丽丝穿着朴素纯净的村姑蓝色棉布长裙与白色围裙，金发扎成温柔的单马尾。她弯腰将刚采摘的野花束抱在怀中，回过头来向你展露出毫无骑士重担的明朗笑颜，金黄色的阳光洒在她泛着健康红晕的脸颊上，宛如大地之母般纯善动人。
data.action: standing in swaying golden wheat field holding bouquet of wildflowers, blue peasant dress and white apron, golden ponytail, sunny radiant smile looking back
data.location: sun-drenched golden wheat field beside a small wooden cottage under clear blue sky
data.lighting: brilliant golden afternoon sunlight sweeping across the endless fields
data.mood: peaceful pastoral paradise, pure heartwarming nostalgia
data.promptProse: Standing amidst golden swaying wheat in Rulid Village, Alice wears a simple peasant dress and white apron holding a cluster of wildflowers. Afternoon sunbeams highlight her golden ponytail as she smiles back with pastoral radiance.
data.animaCaption: Alice in an apron holding wildflowers amidst golden wheat fields, smiling radiantly.
